expectations.text: Scans codebase for hardcoded values that should use existing tokens
expectations.evidence: Runs systematic scan: grep for hex colors, px values, font declarations outside token files; cross-references against existing 200+ token set

expectations.text: Identifies redundant or duplicate tokens in the token set
expectations.evidence: Token deduplication analysis finds 18 near-duplicate tokens (e.g., gray-200 vs neutral-light with same hex value), recommends consolidation

expectations.text: Checks component consistency against design system standards
expectations.evidence: Component audit checks each component against token usage, spacing scale adherence, and naming convention compliance

expectations.text: Flags specific files where developers created new tokens instead of reusing
expectations.evidence: Produces file-level violation report: 34 files with hardcoded values, 12 files with ad-hoc token definitions, organized by severity

expectations.text: Produces an audit report with specific violations and remediation priorities
expectations.evidence: Outputs design-system-audit.md with violation categories, file-level findings, token consolidation recommendations, and prioritized remediation plan
